thread:
alex: Quick follow-up from the attention-kernel RFC — we still don't have a clear short plan for when to prefer Triton microkernels vs CUDA/CUTLASS fallbacks. Can we list the concrete tradeoffs and a small action plan?

maria: Agree. High level: Triton = faster iteration, easier to express novel attention patterns; CUTLASS/CUDA = battle-tested, better for vendor-tuned GEMM, memory predictability on older cards.

sam: Also consider binary size and compilation cost. Triton kernels bloat image if we precompile many variants. CUTLASS can be shipped as a smaller runtime with dynamic config.

jin: From perf runs yesterday: for seq_len<=512, Triton custom attention wins on A100 by ~8-12% p99; for long sequences >2048, CUTLASS path with chunked matmul + KV-sweep is more consistent and uses less peak memory. I can paste the histogram.

leo: Important infra constraint — Dedicated customers on multi-tenant nodes want deterministic memory caps. CUTLASS path lets us set static workspace limits. Triton often needs dynamic scratch allocations for some fusions.

rachel: Does quantization strategy affect decision? If we use int8 kernels, CUTLASS + cuBLASLt offers more mature int8 paths. Triton can still call custom int8, but we need more validation.

kernel-bot: perf-run: 1794999001 completed. Benchmark set: tiny-chat(128), med(512), long(2048). A100: Triton wins tiny/med, CUTLASS wins long. V100: CUTLASS wins all.

alex: Good data. Proposal: define a small selection surface and fallback policy in code:

1) preferred_kernel = function(model_shape, device_props, quant_mode) -> [t Triton, c CUTLASS]
2) allow runtime override per-tenant via config flag
3) compile-on-demand limits: only allow Triton JIT for models in the fast-path whitelist

We need owners and a short timeline.

maria: I can draft the selection matrix. Columns: seq_len buckets, batch size, quant_mode, device_arch, memory_budget. Rows: prefer Triton/CUTLASS + rationale. Will do by Tue.

jin: I'll prototype a lightweight decision API and a fallback hook in runtime. Simple signature:

```
choose_kernel(model_id, seq_len, batch, device_desc, tenant_policy) -> {kernel: "triton"|"cutlass", reason: "string"}
```

I'll wire perf counters when we flip. Target PR by next Wed.

sam: Action: build a small perf harness for edge cases: seq_len=1024 with kv-cache-heavy workloads, varying quant and workspace limits. I'll own harness and run across our fleet images. ETA 2 weeks.

leo: Ops: we need a safety valve for Dedicated nodes — if Triton compile causes OOM or slowdowns, auto-switch to CUTLASS and log an incident. I'll add a node-level watchdog.

rachel: I'll own validation for int8 paths — make a checklist of quality metrics (perplexity dev set, token-level BLEU where applicable, and calibration plots). Two-week window.

alex: Nice. One more thing: document the cost delta (tokens/s and GPU-hours) for each choice so sales/CS can map to pricing. Maria, add cost estimates to the matrix.

maria: Will do. I'll include sample numbers from the perf-run and conservative multipliers for on-prem.
